patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.quoteLong: I got up in the night for the bathroom and my hip just gave out. Now my right leg looks shorter and turned out funny, and I can't put any weight on it at all.
clinical.presentationShort: 82yo F — ground-level fall; R leg shortened & externally rotated, unable to bear weight, NV intact distally.
clinical.presentationLong: 82-year-old female, ground-level fall at home, right leg shortened and externally rotated, unable to bear weight, neurovascularly intact distally.

diagnosis.disposition: Acute → hip/pelvis X-ray, analgesia, ortho for operative fixation; screen for WHY she fell (syncope? meds?).
diagnosis.why: Shortened + externally rotated + can't bear weight = hip fracture till proven otherwise. Always ask why she fell. Multi-resource → Acute.

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.who: 82-year-old woman in a nightgown and cardigan
aiImageGeneration.pose: seated, right leg turned outward, unable to stand
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character. Match the painterly STYLE of the attached reference image - its brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting and palette - but do NOT copy its cropping, camera distance or composition. FRAMING (follow exactly): a full-body WIDE SHOT, square 1:1, 3/4 front view, subject centred. The ENTIRE figure must be inside the frame from the top of the head to the soles of both feet, and the ENTIRE wheelchair must be inside the frame including both large rear wheels and the footplates meeting the floor. Leave clear empty margin on all four sides - roughly 10% of the image width as space above the head and below the feet. This is NOT a close-up, NOT a bust, NOT a head-and-shoulders portrait, NOT a cropped view: the camera is pulled well back so the whole person and the whole chair sit comfortably inside the picture with room around them. Draw the COMPLETE body - head, neck, torso, both arms, both hands, lap, both legs, both feet with shoes. Nothing cropped by the edges, no missing or truncated limbs, no body part fading out or left unfinished. ANATOMY AND OBJECTS (critical): exactly one head, exactly two arms ending in exactly two hands, exactly two legs ending in two feet, five fingers on each hand. No extra, duplicated, floating or partial limbs anywhere. Anything the character touches must be plausibly held by one of those two hands. All furniture is solid and fully opaque - the chair must never look transparent or see-through, and its back, seat and legs must all be completely drawn. Subject: a white 82-year-old woman in a nightgown and cardigan, sitting in a hospital WHEELCHAIR (not an ordinary dining chair) with large rear wheels and footplates. Pose: sitting back in the wheelchair, plainly unable to stand or bear weight; her right leg is visibly shorter than the left and rotated outward so that the right foot turns out to the side; both hands guard her right hip. Expression: pale, drawn and in constant pain. Clearly visible: the right leg rotated outward at the hip with the foot turned out to the side; the right leg noticeably shorter than the left; both hands guarding the right hip; a hospital wheelchair with large rear wheels and footplates. Overall: an elderly woman in significant pain who cannot stand. No text, no logos, no watermarks, no border.
